primary_kpi.metric: 25 commercially relevant tracked keywords in Google Top 5
primary_kpi.note: Operating KPI, not a guarantee. GSC average position is directional and should be verified with query/page evidence.

business_goal: Build a healthy, technically reliable website that grows qualified organic renovation leads in Antwerpen + approximately 25 km and attracts architects, interior architects and designers looking for a reliable execution/work partnership.
success_definition: 25 primary commercially relevant keywords progressing to Google Top 5 by 2026-12-31
website remains technically healthy, crawlable, indexable and conversion-ready
organic visibility produces qualified renovation enquiries rather than traffic-only growth
Reno Rangers becomes discoverable to architects, interior architects and designers seeking an execution partner
weekly work prioritizes lead value, business fit and ranking opportunity over vanity traffic
operating_principle: Use the same growth logic as IsoproTech: protect technical health first, use live Search Console + Keyword Planner evidence, focus weekly effort on the highest-value ranking opportunity, and connect SEO work to qualified lead generation. Do not optimize only for bathroom terms that are already strong; grow broader renovation and contractor authority and a dedicated B2B partnership footprint.

keyword_layers.purpose: Capture users already looking for renovation execution.
Capture broader contractor searches with strong commercial intent.
keyword_layers.relevance_rule: Do not target new-build or services Reno Rangers does not actually perform merely because GSC impressions exist. Keep business fit above raw volume.

keyword_layers.purpose: Combine renovation intent with real service area and project type.
Capture owners, landlords and investors who treat renovation as an asset decision.
keyword_layers.claim_rule: Do not invent ROI, resale uplift, rental uplift, payback or exact financial outcomes. Use current evidence or frame as factors/considerations.

keyword_layers.purpose: Generate partnership opportunities from architects, interior architects and designers who need a dependable execution partner for renovation projects.
keyword_layers.page_intent: Professional collaboration / execution partner page for architects and designers. Explain drawings/specifications workflow, planning, communication, execution coordination and handover without inventing credentials or capacities.
keyword_layers.conversion_goal: Partnership/contact enquiry from an architect, interior architect or designer.

keyword_layers.purpose: Capture users before they select a contractor.
Reach people who feel the renovation problem before they search for a contractor.
keyword_layers.content_rule: Map problem -> symptom -> possible renovation solution -> relevant service -> commercial page -> lead. Do not force renovation as the answer when diagnosis or another specialist may be needed.

website_health_gate.rule: Do not sacrifice technical health for content velocity.
weekly_checks: important URLs return 200 and remain crawlable/indexable
no new broken internal links or redirect mistakes
sitemap and robots behavior remain intentional
tracking and conversion paths remain functional
avoid keyword cannibalization before expanding content

lead_quality_rule: Prefer keywords and changes likely to generate renovation enquiries, larger project opportunities or B2B partnership enquiries. Traffic growth without business relevance is not a successful sprint.
evidence_priority: Antwerp local Google Ads Keyword Planner demand
Belgium Keyword Planner demand for market breadth
business fit and likely lead value
existing page authority and cannibalization risk
selection_rule: Maintain a 25-keyword primary scoreboard for the year-end KPI. A broader discovery universe may be used, but weekly reporting must distinguish the 25 primary KPI terms from secondary discovery terms. Promote or replace a KPI term only when live evidence and business fit justify it.
weekly_sprint_rule: FAST GROWTH MODE: each weekly sprint focuses on the highest-value near-win cluster first, especially primary commercial keywords roughly positions 4-20 with real impressions and Antwerp demand. Use the strongest safe combination of on-page relevance + internal authority support when justified. Avoid cosmetic micro-fixes and avoid repeatedly spending sprints on very distant terms while closer commercially valuable Top-5 opportunities exist. All safety and approval rules remain unchanged.
page_creation_rule: Create a new page only when evidence shows distinct intent not adequately served by an existing page, after cannibalization and internal-link review. New public URLs remain approval-gated before autonomous publishing.

fast_growth_mode.objective: Reach meaningful Top-5 gains as quickly as possible without sacrificing technical health, conversion quality, or factual accuracy.
prioritization: First prioritize commercially relevant primary keywords already ranking roughly positions 4-20 with real GSC impressions and Antwerp demand.
Prefer near-win keywords where one existing page already matches intent and can be strengthened without cannibalization.
Do not spend repeated weekly sprints on terms around position 30-60 when closer Top-5 opportunities with comparable lead value exist.
When safe policy allows it, combine one on-page relevance improvement with one authority-support action such as contextual internal linking from an existing relevant page.
If a high-value term is already Top 5, protect it and shift effort to the next closest commercially valuable term.
fast_growth_mode.weekly_success_test: A sprint should have a credible path to measurable ranking movement within the next few GSC refresh cycles; cosmetic changes without a ranking hypothesis are not enough.
fast_growth_mode.constraints: All existing safety, approval, claim, technical-health, and max-pages rules still apply.
